evidence: Pinned official source and provider documentation; reconstructed offline transport responses, not recorded cloud traffic.
boundaries: Release operations read the exact repository and require DOCKER format before submitting a build or uploading its source; absence and unknown reads cause no writes.
Repository infrastructure belongs only to the project-shared reviewed engine graph, with provider and engine deletion protection.
An existing repository without exact engine ownership is a collision to preserve and block, not permission to create, delete, or implicitly import.
limitations: The source snapshots are reviewed semantics, not a complete compiled response-schema validator.
Configuration validation uses the pinned local provider without cloud calls; live creation, permissions and successful builds remain separately verified.
